key_values.event_name: Hurricane Harvey Houston catastrophic rainfall flooding

criteria.name: Final numeric ledger
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON fields with the correct threshold state and diagnosis label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points when the answer is mostly structured correctly but omits one or two required fields.

criteria.name: Rainfall conversions and duration
criteria.description: Computes 7 days, 1224.3 mm, 904.2 mm, and 609.6 mm from the Harvey record values.
criteria.partial_credit: Award proportional credit for each correct value; cap at 2 points if the unit conversion formula is wrong.

criteria.name: Duration ratio checks
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct formulas with one arithmetic or rounding error.

criteria.name: Minimum water volume
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the correct area-depth method with a unit error, or 1 point for identifying the area-depth multiplication only.

criteria.name: Threshold state
criteria.description: Applies all inequalities and returns pass_multiday_volume plus fail_two_day_only.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for one correct threshold result or for correct logic with one missed inequality.

criteria.name: Computed interpretation
criteria.description: Uses the ratios and volume result to reject a two-day-only interpretation.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the rejection is present but tied to only one computed value.

criteria.name: Concise scope
criteria.description: Keeps the answer focused on the rainfall ledger and avoids extra loss estimates.
criteria.partial_credit: Award this point when the interpretation stays subordinate to the computations.

provenance.method: Local event dates plus Harvey technical-report rainfall, footprint, and population anchors are parsed and converted with explicit unit formulas.
